title: Manage the Copilot experience on Windows devices
problem: Copilot on Windows changes frequently and admins need to control what users see.
steps: Entra users get the Microsoft Copilot app (previously the Microsoft 365 app) pinned; licensed users can switch between Work and Web.

Set what the Copilot key (or Win+C) opens with the WindowsAI CSP `./User/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/WindowsAI/SetCopilotHardwareKey` (GPO: Windows Components > Windows Copilot > Set Copilot Hardware Key).
Block the consumer Copilot app (package MICROSOFT.COPILOT) with AppLocker, or remove it per device; deploy the apps you want with Intune per group.
Communicate to users what the Copilot key opens in your tenant.
pitfalls: The legacy 'Turn off Windows Copilot' policy (TurnOffWindowsCopilot) is slated for deprecation — Microsoft recommends AppLocker instead.
done_when: The Copilot key (or Win+C) opens the app you chose on a test device.
The consumer Copilot app is blocked or removed where you decided it should be.
Users have been told what the key opens.
